name: set
description: 统一管理 MOSS 用户资源与权限模式（kind = skill / rule / hook / command / mode）。action：list 列出全部（只读）；create 新建；update 修改现有项（名称不可变，未提供的字段保持原值）；delete 删除；kind=skill 额外支持 search（按 keyword 搜索 SkillHub 技能市场）与 install（按 canonicalName（@owner/slug）从市场安装）；kind=mode 仅支持 action=set，用 mode=ask/auto/skip 申请切换当前会话权限模式（提权会触发用户确认）。skill/command 名称必须匹配 ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$。rule 支持 scope=global/project、paths（空数组=始终注入，有值=访问匹配文件时注入）、priority；hook 支持 event / matcher / hookType / command / modulePath / timeout，terminal 钩子会执行任意命令，请谨慎使用；command 的 content 是斜杠命令提示词模板（可含 $ARGUMENTS）。list/search 只读放行；create/update/delete/install/set 属于写操作，可能触发用户确认。
description_en: Unified management of MOSS user resources and permission mode (kind = skill / rule / hook / command / mode). action: list all (read-only); create; update an existing item (name is immutable; omitted fields keep their current values); delete; for kind=skill, search the SkillHub market by keyword or install by canonicalName (@owner/slug); kind=mode only supports action=set with mode=ask/auto/skip to request switching the current session permission mode (escalation requires user confirmation). skill/command names must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$. rule supports scope=global/project, paths (empty = always injected, non-empty = injected when matching files are accessed), and priority; hook supports event / matcher / hookType / command / modulePath / timeout — terminal hooks execute arbitrary commands, use with caution; command content is the slash-command prompt template (may contain $ARGUMENTS). list/search are read-only; create/update/delete/install/set are write operations and may require user confirmation.

kind.description: 资源类型；mode 用于切换当前会话权限模式
kind.description_en: Resource kind; mode switches the current session permission mode

action.description: 操作类型；search/install 仅用于 kind=skill，set 仅用于 kind=mode
action.description_en: Operation; search/install are only valid for kind=skill, set is only valid for kind=mode

mode.description: kind=mode 时要切换到的权限模式：ask=逐项确认 / auto=AI 审查 / skip=全部放行
mode.description_en: Target permission mode for kind=mode: ask = per-action confirmation / auto = AI review / skip = allow all

name.description: 目标名称（create/update/delete/list 过滤）。skill/command 必须匹配 ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$；update 时不可改名。
name.description_en: Target name (create/update/delete/list filter). skill/command must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$; names are immutable on update.

id.description: rule/hook 的内容哈希 id；update/delete 时优先于 name，用于精确指定同名多项。
id.description_en: Content-hash id for rule/hook; takes precedence over name for update/delete when multiple items share a name.

scope.description: rule/hook 作用域：global（~/.moss）或 project（当前工作目录 .moss）。缺省 global；update 时沿用原作用域。
scope.description_en: Scope for rule/hook: global (~/.moss) or project (current cwd .moss). Defaults to global; update keeps the existing scope.

description.description: 描述（skill create 必填；其余可选）
description.description_en: Description (required when creating a skill; optional otherwise)

content.description: 正文内容：skill 的提示词 / rule 的规则正文 / command 的提示词模板
content.description_en: Body content: skill prompt / rule body / command prompt template

enabled.description: 启用状态（skill/command 写入 config；rule/hook 写入记录）
enabled.description_en: Enabled state (skill/command written to config; rule/hook stored in the record)

paths.description: rule 的 glob 路径列表；空数组 = 始终注入
paths.description_en: Rule glob paths; empty array = always injected

priority.description: rule 同名冲突优先级（高者胜）
priority.description_en: Rule priority for same-name conflicts (higher wins)

matcher.description: hook 工具名匹配（精确名或 glob；仅工具类事件有效）
matcher.description_en: Hook tool-name matcher (exact name or glob; tool events only)

hookType.description: hook 执行形式：terminal 外部命令 / module TS 模块
hookType.description_en: Hook execution type: terminal command / module TS file

command.description: hookType=terminal 时的命令行（支持 ~ 展开与环境变量）
command.description_en: Command line when hookType=terminal (supports ~ expansion and env vars)

modulePath.description: hookType=module 时的模块路径（相对 hooks/scripts/）
modulePath.description_en: Module path when hookType=module (relative to hooks/scripts/)

timeout.description: hook 执行超时 ms（0 = 使用引擎默认）
timeout.description_en: Hook execution timeout in ms (0 = engine default)

icon.description: skill/command 的图标（Lucide kebab-case 名，或 .svg 文件名）
icon.description_en: Icon for skill/command (Lucide kebab-case name or .svg filename)

allowedTools.description: skill 激活时建议允许的工具列表（提示性约束）
allowedTools.description_en: Suggested allowed tools when the skill is active (advisory)

argumentHint.description: command 的参数提示（菜单展示，如 [issue-number]）
argumentHint.description_en: Command argument hint shown in menus (e.g. [issue-number])

canonicalName.description: skill 市场安装标识，格式 @owner/slug
